failureClass: Unobserved or falsely accepted Alchemy Preview desired-state and live-state drift
acceptedMechanism: One Preview-only native Alchemy desired plan plus Sync.plan dry-run uses a Schema-decoded unique exact-project Vercel credential set, rejects Team scope, observes exact manifest projects, and is classified through an Effect Schema report bound to branded repository/run/attempt identity, source SHA, static authority fingerprint and decoded manifest digest, wrapped by the fixed bounded receipt, and published only as a report-only GitHub run/check disposition.
signal: Pull request for main, the exact weekly schedule, or one manual read-only dispatch.
durableState: The branded repository/run/attempt identity, exact source SHA, static authority fingerprint, decoded manifest digest, fingerprint-only classified report and bounded receipt for that run.
authority: docs/operations/authority-register.json#github-infrastructure-drift and the workflow-bound static read-only authority policy; dynamic execution identity is derived separately from trusted GitHub context.
convergence: One current report per source/ref; newer work cancels stale work; no-op requires zero desired-plan changes and accepted native-sync observations.
proofPerRun: Schema-valid repository/run/attempt identity, source SHA, stage, static authority fingerprint, decoded manifest digest, desired-plan counts, classified per-resource findings, provider-writes:0, command disposition and independent GitHub run/check readback when externally observed.
boundedFailure: Twenty-minute job timeout, exact repository/fork gate, Preview-only stage, three exact secret artifacts, dedicated project-scoped Vercel bindings with no Team fallback, fail-closed missing/duplicate/unmatched custody, and nonzero failed or inconclusive status.
repairRoute: No automatic repair. A human opens the target-owned Alchemy runbook, obtains exact apply authority, re-reads state, repairs one accepted property and proves convergence.
falsePositiveCost: One read-only provider run plus human review of a fingerprint-only finding; no provider or state write.
carryingCost: One weekly read-only run plus same-repository pull-request runs, bounded hosted duration and review attention.
reviewTrigger: Alchemy version, state shape, provider read contract, secret binding, workflow trigger, stage, classification, false positive, cost, missing run, or alert-owner change.
stopAndRollback: Stop on widened permission, Production target, missing or ambiguous readback, secret leak, unexpected plan class, provider write, stale run, or missing receipt. Revert the workflow source or separately disable/revoke its read-only environment and credentials.
retirementCondition: Retire if the signal no longer detects actionable drift, carrying cost exceeds accepted value, or a smaller earlier provider-owned control proves the same postcondition.
disconfirmingEvidence: A green repository suite without a native provider read does not prove no drift.
A successful command or run without classified resource postconditions does not prove convergence.
A current report does not prove a future run, alert delivery, provider availability, or repair.
remindersToRetire: Remove provisional drift scheduling prose once the executable workflow, typed registers and runbook are current.
